offerings.name: Search API
offerings.pricing: 2 credits per 10 results; credits are shared across all endpoints. Paid plans include monthly credits and pay-as-you-go adds credits in $5 USD increments: 1,000 credits on Hobby, 2,000 on Standard, 2,500 on Growth, and 5,000 on Scale.
offerings.price_basis: Hobby pay-as-you-go add-on (1,000 credits per $5; 2 credits per 10 results)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果 (web/news/images 的标题、描述/片段、URL、位置等；可通过 scrapeOptions 获取页面 Markdown/HTML/链接/截图)
offerings.note: Gov category searches add no search credits. ZDR search costs 10 credits per 10 results (enterprise zdr) or 2 credits per 10 results (enterprise anon). Scraping search results incurs normal per-page credits. Free plan covers about 500 searches per month. Price varies by plan and PAYG tier.
